A '''frigate''' was owned by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Malik Carr]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It saw [[Battle of Bilbringi (Yuuzhan Vong War)|action]] in the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]], where it engaged the [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]-[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Thurse]]'' before its commanders allowed it to appear to be driven off by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] vessel.<ref name="NJO" />
